theme_links.notes: 一对多链接仅在产品family与交付stage构成family/stage完整等价时展开；facility、thermal、heat rejection、DCIM、design/EPC/commissioning与operations分别投影到本链自有canonical节点。供电、备电储能、水与环境约束、客户部署利用率保持unmapped：power_electronics_power_supply_equipment、new_energy_storage、new_power_system_smart_grid、industrial_software保留完整canonical所有权，不因数据中心场景重复归属。
uhv_hvdc_flexible_dc -> grid_connection_transmission_protection 仅用于阶段级L3覆盖，不是柔直或换流阀产品等价映射；具体产品与收入口径以主题 claim 和公司 mapping 边界为准。
core_mechanical_components catalog仍为L2 skeleton，尚无可承接这些主题节点的自有L3/L4 canonical node，因此本轮不建立部分等价或一对多链接；不映射整机、机器人关节、机床系统或人形机器人场景节点，待该canonical chain扩展精确基础件节点后再逐项回填。
industrial_inspection_metrology_machine_vision catalog仍为L2 skeleton，尚无可承接相机、光路、采集、算法、专用检测、计量、集成或服务节点的自有L3/L4 canonical node；目录仅做语义精确映射，宽节点不得映到窄节点，因此本轮全部保持unmapped，待canonical chain扩展后逐项回填。
industrial_robots catalog仍为L2 skeleton，尚无承接本体、专用控制、工艺包、集成和服务的自有L3/L4 canonical node，因此本轮10个主题节点全部保持unmapped；伺服、减速器和通用视觉分别属于工业自动化、核心机械与机器视觉的跨链依赖，仅保留应用关系，不重复所有权。

完整等价依据：主题父节点范围=通用动力电芯产品+BMS平台；目录L3范围=generic power-battery cell products and BMS platforms；主题BMS子节点范围=状态估计、均衡、保护、充电、诊断与系统接口；目录L4范围=state estimation, balancing, protection, charging, diagnostics and system interfaces；主题父子层级与目录L3/L4父子层级一致。映射排除Pack集成收入，也排除高比能电芯窄节点；目录高比能电芯L4窄于本主题宽动力电芯家族，钠离子/固态又是验证期混合节点，因此不强连。资源、材料、铜铝箔、结构件和回收尚无完整等价canonical节点，全部保持unmapped，待目录扩展后回填。

目录当前只有 intelligent_driving_smart_cockpit 的 L2 skeleton，没有完整等价的自有L3/L4节点，因此12个主题节点全部保持unmapped。摄像头、毫米波雷达、激光雷达等感知硬件仅表达跨链应用依赖；线控执行硬件归 electric_drive_chassis_by_wire_thermal_management 链；座舱SoC与车规芯片本体归 automotive_electronics_chip_applications 链。本主题只研究智能驾驶与智能座舱应用、软件、域控、集成和量产验证，不重复所有权。

automotive_electronics_chip_applications catalog仍为L2 skeleton，尚无完整等价的自有L3/L4 canonical node，因此本轮10个主题节点全部保持unmapped。汽车功率器件仅表达对 `power_semiconductors` 的应用依赖；AEC-Q、功能安全与可靠性验证不重复 `semiconductor_packaging_test_advanced_packaging` 的封装测试所有权；智驾和座舱功能软件仍归 `intelligent_driving_smart_cockpit`。本主题聚焦芯片与ECU/域控硬件的车规应用、认证和量产验证，不重复所有权。

commercial_space_launch catalog仍为L2 skeleton，尚无完整等价的自有L3/L4 canonical node，因此12个主题节点全部保持unmapped。卫星制造、星载载荷、星座和地面站归 `satellite_manufacturing_space_infrastructure`；民机、航空发动机及其材料归 `civil_aircraft_aero_engines`。通用材料、增材、锻件、功率器件与半导体只表达跨链依赖；本主题不以宽航天、军工或航空航天收入替代商业火箭收入。
主题研究节点按投资阅读逻辑聚合；前端EDA、后端实现签核、IP、设计服务和设计使能节点分别映射到完整L3/L4目录族。许可订阅与版税模式、客户采用与收入验证属于跨节点商业判断，不建立canonical所有权。晶圆制造能力仍归 wafer_manufacturing_specialty_processes。
主题研究按存储晶圆、控制器、模组/SSD、企业存储和商业验证聚合。价格周期、库存和客户收入验证是跨节点研究判断，不建立 canonical 所有权。HBM 仅映射技术节点，不代表任何公司自动获得受益映射。
主题研究聚合机床专用控制、结构与部件集成、整机和生命周期服务。通用伺服、编码器、丝杠、导轨、轴承和材料的canonical所有权仍留在工业自动化、传感器、核心机械基础件和材料链；本链只拥有面向机床精度与工艺的系统集成角色。订单、发货、验收和收入属于跨节点商业验证，不建立canonical所有权。
主题研究拥有卫星平台、载荷硬件、星上系统、卫星专用地面链路、批量制造和在轨基础设施运营。运载火箭、发射场和发射服务仍归`commercial_space_launch`；通用半导体与地面网络设备只表达卫星场景集成，不重复canonical所有权；星座规划、合同、交付、发射、在轨验收和服务收入必须分阶段验证。

E1 owns downstream application access, communications delivery, PNT augmentation, remote-sensing data processing, vertical integration, utilization, pricing, renewal and recognized service revenue. Satellite platforms, payload hardware, onboard systems, batch manufacturing, launch handoff, in-orbit infrastructure operations, gateways and terminals retain canonical ownership in `satellite_manufacturing_space_infrastructure`; hardware-only evidence cannot create an E1 reviewed beneficiary.

E2 owns cross-domain orchestration, cooperative traffic applications, mobility operations, project delivery, utilization and renewal validation. Vehicle interfaces, roadside/V2X infrastructure, cloud data platform and security governance remain canonical dependencies; generic hardware evidence cannot create an E2 reviewed beneficiary.
E3按frontier route表达侵入式、微创与非侵入式接口、信号采集、解码、神经调控、整机、临床注册和商业兑现；不创建canonical所有权或composition。政策、投资、联盟、实验室、专利、原型、临床、注册、交付和收入必须分阶段验证，通用康复、脑电、刺激、传感、手术及医疗器械收入不得自动计入E3。
E4按frontier route表达聚变约束路线、磁体低温、加热电源、真空氚循环、面向等离子体部件、诊断控制、制造交付和收入验证；不创建裂变节点或canonical所有权。核电设备仍归属nuclear_power_equipment，通用超导、材料、低温和核工业能力不得自动形成聚变受益映射，装置订单不得外推为商业聚变发电收入。
主题研究聚合手术、介入、生命支持、设备专用耗材、核心部件集成、注册准入和存量服务。医学影像、超声和内镜设备仍归`medical_imaging_diagnostic_equipment`，体外诊断仍归`in_vitro_diagnostics`；本链只记录跨专科平台和非影像高端器械角色。注册、临床、集采、进院、装机、手术/检查量、耗材消耗、服务和收入必须分阶段验证。
E5按frontier route分别表达量子计算、QKD量子通信、量子精密测量、标准部署及采购服务收入；不创建canonical所有权。PQC只能作为相邻路线，股权投资、联盟或标准成员身份不构成量子受益证据，通用算力、光器件、芯片、低温和仪器产品无量子专用交付角色时不得映射，宽口径收入不得外推为量子专项收入。

F1 owns model platforms, adaptation toolchains, agents, AI application products, vertical delivery, monetization/adoption, and model/application governance. AI chips, servers, racks, cloud/data-center/power, OS/database/general software, generic industrial software, and generic security remain typed dependencies unless evidence identifies an AI-specific product or governance role.

F3 owns mobile 5G/5G-A radio, mobile core and bearer roles plus mobile-specific deployment economics. 6G research, prototypes and trials remain distinct from commercial deployment, orders and revenue; satellite, generic optics, generic RF chips, cloud-edge-network and cybersecurity keep external ownership.

F4 owns analog, mixed-signal and RF chip products. MEMS sensors, discrete power switching, foundry capacity, mobile network systems, optical communications and satellite systems keep external ownership.

G1 owns MEMS devices, MEMS-specific processes and packaging, direct MEMS fusion modules, and MEMS commercial validation. Generic foundry, analog chips, non-MEMS sensors, industrial inspection systems and humanoid-specific integration retain neighboring-chain ownership.

F5 owns direct rare-earth resource, separation, metal, permanent-magnet, recycling and market-validation roles. Downstream motor, robotics, wind, EV and electronics demand does not map companies; mixed tungsten, molybdenum, non-rare-earth mining and generic nonferrous revenue remain excluded.

G2 owns wafer-manufacturing and specialty-process platforms plus fab economics and foundry customer validation. Equipment, materials, fabless design, packaging, MEMS devices, analog/RF chips and power-device products retain neighboring-chain ownership.

G3 owns conventional civil-airliner structures, civil aero-engine systems, civil-aircraft subsystems and the airworthiness-to-installed-base lifecycle. Military-only aircraft, helicopters, low-altitude/eVTOL/UAV, commercial space and generic advanced materials retain neighboring-chain ownership.
